versions.name: Camp Simpson

features.note: Black powder rifles on the shooting skills range.
Climbing is taught in the outdoor skills area.
The Mabee Dining Hall is the centre for all food and dining activities.
The Trailblazer program, in which new Scouts work the skills for Tenderfoot through First Class.
Outdoor skills covers environmental science, forestry, insect study, and nature.
Swimming and lifesaving instruction, including BSA Lifeguard.
A full waterfront area carrying all boating and swimming programme.

versions.summary: Arbuckle Area Council's fully accredited 2,000-acre Scouts BSA resident camp near Tishomingo, Oklahoma.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
